aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video. 'auto' picks a ratio from your prompt and any inputs.
aspect_ratio.title: aspect_ratio

draft.description: Generate a fast, low-cost draft preview instead of a full-quality clip. Drafts are 720p.
draft.title: Draft

duration.description: Length of the generated clip in seconds. 'auto' lets the model pick to fit the content. Three or more images need an explicit duration.
duration.title: duration

generate_audio.description: Generate synchronized audio (ambient sound, speech, effects). Set to false for a silent clip.
generate_audio.title: Generate Audio

images.description: Optional images to drive the video, placed on screen pixel for pixel. One image opens the clip (image-to-video). Two images start and end it. Three or more (up to 10) become a storyboard — the first starts it, the last ends it, and the rest fall evenly in between (needs a duration). Leave empty for text-to-video. Must be PNG, JPEG, or WebP.
images.title: Images

prompt.description: Text description of the video to generate. Plain language works — the prompt is interpreted and expanded before generation. Describe the scene, action, camera moves, and any audio you want.
prompt.title: Prompt

safety_tolerance.description: Moderation tolerance for input and output, 0 (strictest) to 4 (most permissive). Requests with image or video inputs are limited to 2.
safety_tolerance.title: Safety Tolerance

start_video.description: A video to continue from its final frames. Use this to extend a shot or chain generations into a longer sequence. Must be an mp4, at most 50MB and 15 seconds. Can't be combined with images.
start_video.title: Start Video

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image. 'auto' picks the ratio from the prompt and the first reference image.
aspect_ratio.title: aspect_ratio

grounding.description: Let the model research the prompt with web search and image search before generating.
grounding.title: Grounding

images.description: Up to 10 reference images the prompt edits or draws from. When present, the request runs as an edit and the first image drives 'auto' aspect ratio. Each image must be at least 256x256 px and at most 16 MP. Must be jpeg, png, gif, or webp.
images.title: Images

output_quality.description: Quality when saving the output images, from 0 to 100. 100 is best quality, 0 is lowest quality. Not relevant for .png outputs
output_quality.title: Output Quality

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate, or of the edit to apply to the reference images.
prompt.title: Prompt

resolution.description: Resolution of the output image. Input images are resized to the closest bin, up to 2k.
resolution.title: resolution

safety_tolerance.description: Moderation tolerance for inputs and outputs. 0 is the strictest, 4 is the most permissive.
safety_tolerance.title: Safety Tolerance
